answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region; regional failover succeeded in March degradation with fast latency recovery and clean traffic shift. Rollback is blocked by compliance on the security patch. Read replicas help dashboard load, not write-path latency. Circuit breakers help with dependency failures, not primary capacity saturation. Capacity provisioning is slower than failover during peak settlement load. Failover is the only intervention that can restore write-path latency within minutes while preserving the mandatory security patch and avoiding customer write loss. Settlement peak makes speed critical.
